title: Juicy Grilled Venezuelan Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and light Venezuelan dish featuring chicken skewers grilled to perfection in a banana leaf vessel, infused with the aroma of lime leaves and a touch of nutty flavor, all while being FODMAP friendly. This solo dinner dish is sure to delight.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic-infused oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread 3-4 pieces of chicken onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
Wrap each skewer in a banana leaf, making sure to cover the entire piece of chicken.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
After 8 minutes of cooking, flambe the skewers with a small amount of rum, if desired.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh lime leaves and serve immediately.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
